slots.question: A1
slots.title: Five-mark question 1

content.text: Question 1 is based on the following image and statements in Figure 1.

Charles Babbage was an English mathematician, a philosopher and also an inventor. He was born on 1791 in London England. He was known for his contributions to invent machine X to solve four basic arithmetic functions. The machine X has improved its calculations design from Stepped Reckoner machine and early mechanical calculator. The machine X has introduced a number of computing concepts which are still in use today. Although this machine was not actually completed, it is the first machine that deserved to be called as a computer.
a) What is the machine X name?
b) In which generation does the machine X introduced?
c) What is the function of machine X?
d) Name the machine that has been invented prior to machine X?
e) What is the title given to Charles Babbage due to his success to invent machine X?
